name: D&O
recent: D&O 近期公告以主要股东 Goh Nan Kioh 的持股变动申报为主，另有 KWAP 的持股变动及停止成为主要股东的申报。公司于 2026 年 8 月 21 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩，同时出现薪酬委员会与提名委员会的人事变动。
notable: 主要股东 Goh Nan Kioh 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报持股变动。
KWAP 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日申报停止成为主要股东。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 21 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩。
risks: KWAP 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日申报停止成为主要股东。
主要股东 Goh Nan Kioh 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度营收为 MYR 231.456 百万，环比增长 2.6%，同比减少 5.2%；净亏损为 MYR 25.643 百万，净利率为 -11.1%，较上一季度的 -26.0% 有所收窄，但净亏损同比扩大 3821.8%。

recent_en: D&O's recent announcements mainly comprise substantial shareholder interest changes by Goh Nan Kioh, along with KWAP's interest changes and notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 21 August 2026, alongside changes in its Remuneration and Nomination Committees.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder Goh Nan Kioh filed multiple changes in interest between September and October 2026.
KWAP filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 14 September 2026.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 21 August 2026.
risks_en: KWAP filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 14 September 2026.
Substantial shareholder Goh Nan Kioh filed multiple changes in interest between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 231.456 million, up 2.6% QoQ but down 5.2% YoY; net loss was MYR 25.643 million with a net margin of -11.1%, narrower than the previous quarter's -26.0%, while net loss widened 3821.8% YoY.
